purpose: Prevent a stale upper or distant exact log from consuming the remaining coordinate approach budget when a materially better reachable log becomes visible

source_trace.finding: Fast route replan advanced contact engagement from step 298 to step 185, but target 1 remained selected until post-recovery failure at step 291 even though target 2 later scored about 20 points better.

promotion_protocol.formal_gate_threshold: at least 18/20 with at most 2 max-step failures

smoke_iterations.name: coordinate-aim and recovery-verification preemption with 3-point margin

decision.reason: Both v9.10 targeted smoke iterations remained 3/5, below the predeclared 4/5 threshold.

seed_17509.finding: Exact observations were fragmented across several log targets, so the globally required three observations were not accumulated before recovery verification expired.

decision.next_direction: Use state-conditioned evidence in a new frozen profile: retain three-observation support during ordinary coordinate aim, but permit a one-observation emergency switch during POST_RECOVERY_VERIFY only when the current target has already failed recovery and the new target is lower, reachable, and score-improving.
